title: Segments of a Circle Practice
description: Practice defining circular segments, comparing them with sectors, and finding segment areas.

questions.question: Which description defines a circular segment?
options: A region bounded by two radii and an arc
A region bounded by a chord and its intercepted arc
A line through the center with endpoints on the circle
The distance from the center to the circle
questions.explanation: A circular segment is the region between a chord and the arc intercepted by that chord.

questions.question: Which description defines a sector of a circle?
options: A region bounded by a chord and an arc
A region bounded by two radii and an arc
A segment connecting two points on a circle
A point at the center of a circle
questions.explanation: A sector is bounded by two radii and the arc between them.

questions.question: A circular segment and a sector are always the same region.
questions.explanation: A sector uses two radii as straight boundaries, while a circular segment uses a chord as its straight boundary.

questions.question: A sector has area 50 square units, and the triangle inside it has area 32 square units. Enter the segment area.
questions.explanation: Segment area equals sector area minus triangle area: 50 - 32 = 18.

questions.question: A sector has area 84 cm^2. The triangle formed by the two radii and chord has area 61 cm^2. What is the segment area?
questions.explanation: Subtract the triangle from the sector: 84 - 61 = 23 cm^2.

questions.question: A circle has radius 6 and a 90-degree sector. What is the sector area?
questions.explanation: The sector is one fourth of the circle, so its area is (90/360)pi(6)^2 = 9pi.

questions.question: A 90-degree sector in a circle of radius 6 has area 9pi. If the triangle inside it has area 18, enter the exact segment area.
questions.explanation: The segment area is sector area minus triangle area: 9pi - 18.

questions.question: Explain how a circular segment is different from a sector.
questions.correctAnswer: A circular segment is bounded by a chord and an arc, while a sector is bounded by two radii and an arc.
questions.explanation: The straight boundaries are the key difference: chord for a segment, two radii for a sector.
